help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:330  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:331  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:337  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable (e.g. `--option endpoint=ssh://host:23`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:340  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:344  Is the scheduled archive actually working? Plus what the local harness
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:345  scanner finds (read-only). Add `--destination` to list archived writer
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:346  versions and identify machines behind the newest writer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:347
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:348  The first line answers the question the timer cannot: it reads the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:349  `run-state.json` written by the last `run-once` pass. Three distinct
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:350  answers, and only the first is a healthy one:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:351
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:352  * last run recent and successful -> exit 0
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:353  * last run FAILED -> exit 1, saying which step failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:354  * no run recorded at all, or nothing has run for longer than
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:355    4x `backup_interval_secs` (minimum 1 hour) -> exit 1. A dead timer
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:356    usually leaves a *successful* last run behind, so this overdue check
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:357    is the only thing that catches it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:358
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:359  Never prints session content: counts, timestamps and digests only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:360
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:361  Default output is a handful of lines and nothing more: the verdict
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:362  above, then aggregate scan counts (per-harness session totals, skipped
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:363  roots, unarchivable-session warning). It stays that size whether the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:364  machine holds three sessions or three thousand, so the verdict never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:365  scrolls away.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:366
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:367  `--sessions` adds the per-session metadata table on top of that —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:368  one line per session (harness / bytes / mtime / first 8 chars of the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:369  id). That is the troubleshooting view; it can be hundreds of lines.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:371  Also print one metadata line per session found (can be hundreds).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:374  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:375  human lines still go to stderr). Tri-state fields are tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:376  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:377  `{"kind":"not_applicable",…}` — an unknown is never serialised as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:378  `0`, `null` or a missing field. `run_state.kind` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:379  `known` / `missing` / `unreadable`; `scanner.kind` is `ok` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:380  `failed`. `exit_semantics` documents what the exit code means.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:383  Also list archived per-machine writer versions from a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:386  Repository path override for archived writer versions.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:389  Masterkey file override for archived writer versions.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:392  Concurrency cap override.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:398  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:402  Dump one session back from the repository (sequence-concatenated) and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:403  print its sha256 for verification — or, with `--all-machines`, merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:404  the newest snapshot of every machine and report per-session digests.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:406  Stage directory used by push (mapping into the snapshot tree).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:424  `--all-machines`, which reads every machine.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:427  Named destination from the config. Required once the config

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:447  Diagnostic: does any harness on this machine silently delete its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:448  sessions? Read-only (paths/counts/bytes/timestamps only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:450  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else. Tri-state
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:451  fields are tagged `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:452  / `{"kind":"not_applicable",…}` — an unknown is never serialised as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:453  `0`, `null` or a missing field. `claude.verdict.kind` is one of

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:455  `reclaim.kind` is `ok` / `no_repo` / `no_key` / `open_failed`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:459  Prove the archive is intact. Three independently runnable levels:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:460  l1 = rustic structure check (cheap, no payload reads), l2 = rustic content
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:461  check (downloads and re-hashes every pack), l3 = reconcile against an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:462  expected manifest derived from the sealed staging tree (per session:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:463  shard count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:465  Which level(s) to run: `l1`, `l2`, `l3` or `all`.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:478  Named destination from the config. Required once the config

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:494  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:498  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:499
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:500  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:501  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:502  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:503  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:504  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:505
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:506  A source destination that cannot be consulted makes the difference set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:507  *incomplete*: that is reported and the command exits non-zero. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:508  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:510  Destination to initialise. Must be declared in the config, unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:511  an explicit `--repo` is given instead.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:514  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:517  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:520  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:523  Existing destination to compute the difference set against,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:524  repeatable. Default: every other destination in the config.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:527  Repository path override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:530  Masterkey file override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:533  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:536  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:539  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:542  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:543  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:544  this flag nothing is ever written to `known_hosts`, so the first
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:545  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:549  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:550
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:551  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:552  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:553  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:554  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:555  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart. Use
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:556  `--cost` to see what a full-text pass over the current hits *would*
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:557  cost before asking for one; full-text matching is not implemented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:558
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:559  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:560  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:561
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:562  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:563  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:564  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:565  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:566  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:567  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:568
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:569  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:570  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:571  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:572  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:573  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:574
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:575  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:576  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:577  destination and answered for every session and nothing matched, `3`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:578  could not finish — either reading it, or placing every session in time —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:579  so "nothing matched" is unproven. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:581  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:584  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:587  Emit one JSON object on stdout instead of the human report. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:588  three groups (matched / not matched / could not be placed) stay
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:589  separate fields, so a consumer cannot read an unknown as an absence.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:592  Also report what a full-text pass over the hits would cost.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:595  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:598  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:601  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:604  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:607  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:611  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:612
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:613  One destination per run, always named, exactly like `search` — and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:614  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:615  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:616  command with a different name, and `--dry-run` prints the same price
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:617  `search --cost` reports before anything is fetched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:618
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:619  Layout: `<out>/<machine>/<harness>/<session-id>.jsonl`, each file holding
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:620  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:621  what `read` returns for it. Plus `<out>/manifest.json`: per session its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:622  machine, harness, id, first and last message time, shard count, bytes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:623  written, sha256 of the written file and the filters that were applied —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:624  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:625  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:626  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:627
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:628  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:629  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:630  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:631  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:632  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:633
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:634  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:635  `--day`/`--since`/`--until`. A line whose timestamp cannot be read is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:636  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:637
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:638  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:639  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:640
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:641  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:642  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:643  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:644  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:645  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:646  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:648  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:651  Directory to write into. Must be empty or absent unless `--force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:654  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:657  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:658  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:659  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:660  manifest records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:663  With a time window, also drop lines whose own timestamp lies outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:664  it. Lines whose time cannot be read are kept and counted in the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:665  manifest's `untimed_lines`. Requires a window.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:668  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:669  from an earlier export stay where they are.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:672  Print the plan and stop: no directory is created and no file is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:673  written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:676  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:679  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:682  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:685  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:688  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:692  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:693  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:694
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:695  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:696  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:697  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:698  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:699
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:700  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:701  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:702  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:703  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:704  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:705  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:706  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:707
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:708  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:709  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. The only
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:710  conversation text that read carries is each session's one-line label
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:711  (at most 100 characters, recorded in the activity index); a session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:712  full conversation is fetched and decrypted only when you click it and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:713  then click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:714  codes: 0 served the dashboard — even an archive that holds nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:715  which is served as an honest empty page rather than not starting; 3
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:716  could not finish reading (or no key), and is also the exit status after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:717  serving an archive that could not be read in full; 2 is a usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:719  Deprecated alias for `ui`; prints a one-line notice on stderr and behaves
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:720  identically. Kept for one release.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:799  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:810  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:814  Reclaim the sealed shard body from the staging tree, but only where the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:815  archive provably holds every byte (ADR-020 Phase 4).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:816
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:817  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:818  This command retires the shard body once every declared destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:819  proves it holds each session. Proof means asking the archive itself —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:820  never the local cursor — for every session's digest triple (shard
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:821  count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and matching it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:822  against the stage. A destination that cannot be consulted is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:823  "unproven" and blocks the reclaim: it is never treated as "does not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:824  have it". Every declared destination must prove it holds each session,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:825  or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:826  nothing is deleted.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:827
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:828  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:829  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:830  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:831  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:832  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:833
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:834  Exit codes: 0 = reclaimable (dry run) or reclaimed (apply); 1 =
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:835  blocked — at least one destination is unreachable, partial, or fails
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:836  to hold a session, so nothing was deleted; 2 = usage error.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:863  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:864  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:865  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:866  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:867
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:869  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:870  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:871  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:872  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:873  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:874
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:875  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:876  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:877
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:878  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:879  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:880  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:881  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:882  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:884  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:885  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:886  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:889  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:890  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:891  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:894  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:897  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:898  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:899  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:911  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:914  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:917  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:918  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:919  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:920  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:921  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:922  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:926  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:927
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:928  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:929  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:930  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:931  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:932  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:933
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:934  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:935  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:936  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:937  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:938  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:939
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:940  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:941  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:942  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:944  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:948  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:949
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:950  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:951  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:952  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:953  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:954  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:955  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:956
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:957  With `--rebuild --destination`, every archived session for that machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:958  is restored to a temporary child of `--stage`, the full index is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:959  rebuilt, and a new complete snapshot is appended. Existing snapshots
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:960  remain immutable. No snapshot is written until the scan and every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:961  session restore finish, and only the named machine partition is pushed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:962  The rebuild is safe to re-run, but each run starts over and is not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:963  resumable. A same-machine snapshot found before publication restarts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:964  rebuild so the appended snapshot cannot hide that newer session.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:965
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:966  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:967  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:968  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:969  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:970  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:971
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:972  Metadata, with one declared exception: the extraction keeps a timestamp
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:973  per line and throws the line away, and — for claude-code sessions —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:974  additionally keeps the capped one-line label the dashboard lists the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:975  session under (the harness's own title, or the head of the session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:976  first user line; see the `ui` labels). That label — at most 100
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:977  characters, with its provenance — is the one piece of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:978  conversation-derived text the metadata tier ever holds. Nothing else is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:979  ever kept, and the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:980
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:981  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:982  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:983  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:984  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:985  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:986  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:988  Local stage directory, or an existing workspace directory for a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:989  destination rebuild. Temporary restored shards are removed after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:990  the new snapshot is written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:993  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:994  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:995  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:998  Explicitly rebuild the complete partition index. The command has
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:999  always rebuilt rather than incrementally patched; this spelling is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1000  provided for repair workflows and makes that intent visible.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1003  Destination to rebuild from and append the repaired snapshot to.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1004  Requires `--rebuild`; either this or `--repo` must be named.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1016  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1019  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1023  Write this machine's display-name declaration (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1024
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1025  Writes `<stage>/meta/<machine>/machine.json` — a `MachineDeclaration`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1026  that carries the human display name, the OS and a first-seen time. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1027  machine partition is resolved exactly like every other command: config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1028  `machine` first, then the identity file (generated when missing). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1029  next `push` archives the whole stage root, so this file rides along.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1030
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1031  The display name is taken from `--display-name` when given; otherwise
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1032  the system's LocalHostName (`scutil --get LocalHostName` on macOS,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1033  `hostname` elsewhere) is used. If neither is available the field is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1034  written **empty** and the command says so — a name is never invented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1035
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1036  Exit codes: `0` = the declaration was written; `3` = the machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1037  partition could not be resolved or the identity is unusable; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1038  file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1040  Stage directory to write the declaration into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1043  Human display name for this machine. Default: system LocalHostName.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1047  Give a dead or sold machine a display name (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1048
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1049  Writes `<stage>/meta/<target>/label-by-<local-identity>.json` — a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1050  `LabelRecord` expressing *this* machine's opinion about what `<target>`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1051  should be called. It exists for machines that can no longer declare for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1052  themselves (sold, dead, in a different building). Each file has exactly
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1053  one writer, so concurrent machines never fight over it; the overview
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1054  shows the label with the latest `written_at_unix`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1055
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1056  Exit codes: `0` = the label was written; `3` = the local identity could
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1057  not be resolved; `1` = the file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1059  Stage directory to write the label into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1062  Machine id (partition) being labelled, e.g. a 32-hex identity.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1065  Display-name override for the target.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1069  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1070  (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1071
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1072  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1073  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1074  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1075  `meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`. The paths carry each machine's own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1076  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1077  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1078  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1079  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1080  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1081  conversation content.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1082
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1083  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1084  explicitly as "index missing" — it never vanishes silently, because a missing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1085  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1086
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1087  Exit codes: `0` = at least one index was read and rendered; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1088  whole repository was read and there is no activity index at all (a real
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1089  "there is none", not a failure to look); `3` = the repository could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1090  be read in full (open / snapshot / tree / dump failure) — the absences
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1091  below are unproven; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1093  Destination to open. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1094  there is no default destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1097  Terminal width for the matrix/heatmap (default: 100).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1100  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1101  human matrix/heatmap is suppressed). Per-session `first_unix` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1102  `last_unix` and `time_source` are tri-state tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1103  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` — an unknown
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1104  time is never `null`. `no_index_anywhere` is `true` on exit 1
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1105  (read in full, no index anywhere); a failed read (exit 3) puts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1106  reason in `error`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1109  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1112  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1115  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1118  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1121  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1125  Manage this machine's body cache (ADR-034).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1126
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1127  The body cache holds the conversation bodies a read would otherwise pull
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1128  from a destination again, as the destination's own ciphertext. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1129  disposable by design: nothing here is part of the archive, and deleting
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1130  all of it changes nothing except how long the next read takes. Without a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1131  subcommand it prints the location, the quota and the current occupancy,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1132  so a cache you never meant to have is visible before you clear it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1134  What to do; omit to see the current occupancy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1138  Build or inspect the per-destination local full-text index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1145  `cache` subcommands.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1148  Delete every cached body block.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1149
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1150  Only the cache directory is touched — never the archive, never a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1151  destination, never a key. Entries are re-fetched from the destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1152  the next time a session is read.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1158  Destination to index. Required unless an explicit repository is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1161  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1164  Masterkey file override (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1167  Concurrency cap override (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1170  Backend option key=value, repeatable (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1173  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1180  Read changed sessions from the archive and update the local FTS index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1182  Validate and count indexed sessions without contacting the archive.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1184  Delete this destination's marked local index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1290  The parameters of the remote step, exactly as the caller supplied them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1291
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1292  Every field here is either a name or a location. **No field can carry a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1293  secret**, and that is the point of the shape rather than an accident of it:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1294  the two credential fields are the *names of environment variables*, which the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1295  wizard writes into the config as `env:NAME` and never resolves itself. So a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1296  secret cannot reach the config file as plaintext, and it cannot reach
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1297  `argv` — where it would be captured by the process list and by any log that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1298  echoes the command — because there is no flag that would accept one.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1301  Which recipe to write.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1304  SFTP: `ssh://<host>:<port>`. S3: the service endpoint, e.g.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1305  `https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1308  SFTP only: the ssh user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1311  SFTP only: the private key to authenticate with. Optional — leaving it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1312  out lets the backend use the ssh agent and its own default keys, which is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1313  a real configuration rather than a gap.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1316  S3 only: the bucket (or container) the repository lives in.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1319  S3 only: the region. R2 is single-region and names it `auto`; another
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1320  S3-compatible service names its own.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1323  Both kinds: the prefix inside the account/bucket that the repository
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1324  lives under. Optional, and omitted rather than defaulted: a prefix the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1325  user did not choose would put their archive somewhere they did not name.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1328  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the access key
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1329  id. Not the key id itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1332  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the secret
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1333  access key. Not the secret.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1336  Declare that this host's key was checked out of band, which authorizes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1337  recording it in `~/.ssh/known_hosts`. A declaration, not a verification:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1338  nothing here, and nothing anywhere else, can check that the comparison
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1339  happened. Without it the wizard stops at an unknown host and writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1340  nothing (ADR-039, rejected option E).
